subject: Database Migration — Approval Required
body:
Hi all,

I'm requesting formal approval for the PostgreSQL migration described in ticket NEX-189 and documented in docs/database-migration-plan.md.

Summary of migration:
- Migrating from PostgreSQL 13 to PostgreSQL 16
- Adding partitioning to the events table (currently 180M rows)
- Estimated downtime: 4-hour maintenance window on Sunday Nov 3 at 2 AM IST
- Rollback plan: logical replication standby kept live for 48 hours post-migration

I need approval from:
1. Raj Patel (CTO) — infrastructure sign-off
2. Priya Sharma (Eng Manager) — team coordination
3. Legal/Compliance — data residency confirmation

Please reply to this email with your approval or concerns by Oct 28.

Diana Chen
Database Architect
